description: Hi we are students from uruguay!
summary: We made a space survival video game created in Microsoft MakeCode Arcade by Pedro, Juan, Bruno, Máximo and Tiziano. The player must survive in space by collecting the vital resources every astronaut needs: oxygen, energy, food and protection. If any of these resources runs out, the player loses and has to start again. At the same time, the player must defend space from an alien invasion, and the mission is complete after defeating 35 aliens. Our game shows, in a fun way, one of the biggest challenges of human space exploration: in space, nothing we need to stay alive is easy to get, so astronauts must manage their supplies carefully. By playing, kids can understand why oxygen, food and energy are so important for future missions to the Moon and Mars.
details:
What it does and how it works. The player controls a character in space who has two missions at the same time:

  1. Survive: collect oxygen, energy, food and protection before they run out. If any resource reaches zero, the game is over.
  2. Defend: protect space from attacking aliens. The player wins after defeating 35 aliens.

Benefits and intended impact. The game teaches that astronauts depend on limited resources to stay alive, and that managing them well is just as important as facing dangers. It makes this idea easy to understand for children through play.

Tools used. Microsoft MakeCode Arcade (block-based programming) for the game, and Canva for the presentation.

Creativity. The game combines two challenges at once: an action game (fighting aliens) and a strategy game (keeping your resources from running out), so the player must constantly decide what to do first.

Factors we considered. Which resources are truly essential for survival in space, how to make the game challenging but winnable, and how to work as a team of five programmers on the same project.
